svg.desc: Every MIL-STD-882E task a process map names, with its tailoring
svg.text: Figure 2 · The MIL-STD-882E tasks the maps name
Each map names analyses and plans by abbreviation; matched to the task they stand for (docs/terms.yaml and the task titles), 10 tasks are drawn. Each is
shown with its disposition and gate in the project tailoring.

Generated by tools/figures/diagrams_readme.py from the draw.io sources, their SVG exports and the MIL-STD-882E tailoring. The maps are illustrative draft workflows, not normative flowcharts or evidence of completed tasks.

g.text: Terms: ARP4754B = SAE guidelines for development of civil aircraft and systems · ARP4761A = SAE guidelines for the safety assessment process on civil aircraft · DoD = US Department of Defense · EHA =

environmental hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 210) · FHA = functional hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 208; also ARP4761A aircraft FHA) · G0–G7 = lifecycle gate (G0 concept to G7 change and sustainment) ·

HHA = health hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 207) · MIL-STD-882E = US DoD Standard Practice for System Safety (11 May 2012, base edition) · PHA = preliminary hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 202) · PHL =

preliminary hazard list (MIL-STD-882E Task 201) · SAE = SAE International, publisher of ARP4754B and ARP4761A · SHA = system hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 205) · SRHA = system requirements hazard analysis

(MIL-STD-882E Task 203) · SSHA = subsystem hazard analysis (MIL-STD-882E Task 204) · SSPP = system safety program plan (MIL-STD-882E Task 102) · SVG = Scalable Vector Graphics, the figure file format · US =
